title: TabClustPFN: A Prior-data Fitted Network for Tabular Data Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2601.21656v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) have reframed supervised tabular learning as single-pass in-context inference without per-dataset optimization. Extending this paradigm to clustering is appealing yet fundamentally more challenging, due to absent supervision, unknown cluster cardinality, and label switching inherent to partition outputs. Existing PFN-based clustering methods address these challenges only partially, either requiring known cardinality as input or relying on unstable label-ordering conventions and overly restrictive synthetic priors. We introduce TabClustPFN, a clustering PFN that resolves all challenges jointly through co-designed prior, objective, and architecture. translated_title: TabClustPFN：一种用于表格数据聚类的先验数据拟合网络
translated_abstract: 先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）已将监督式表格学习重构为无需针对每个数据集进行优化的单次上下文内推理。将这一范式扩展到聚类虽然很有吸引力，却面临着更根本性的挑战，原因在于缺乏监督信息、未知的聚类基数（簇的数量），以及划分输出所固有的标签交换问题。现有的基于PFN的聚类方法只能部分地应对这些挑战：要么需要将已知的聚类基数作为输入，要么依赖于不稳定的标签排序约定和限制性过强的合成先验。我们提出了TabClustPFN，这是一种聚类PFN，通过协同设计的先验、训练目标与架构来联合解决上述所有挑战。我们的混合预训练先验能够捕捉异构的真实表格数据几何结构；我们解耦的划分推断网络与基数推断网络架构能够在单次前向传递中同时推断聚类分配和聚类基数；我们的SoftARI训练目标……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TabClustPFN通过协同设计的先验、训练目标与解耦架构，在单次推理中同时推断表格数据的聚类分配和未知聚类基数，从而克服了无监督、基数未知和标签交换等聚类中的核心挑战。
en_tdlr: TabClustPFN is a clustering PFN that jointly infers cluster assignments and unknown cluster cardinality in a single inference pass through a co-designed prior, objective, and architecture, overcoming the challenges of absent supervision, unknown cardinality, and label switching in tabular data clustering.
